'''Screamer Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The unit was made up of dark-colored [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].
